units.summary: Adds a setter that appends the new "from-selected-series" hint to the block meta's Hints and sorts them, without adding duplicates. Follows the same pattern as SetStaleSeries. The hint is written into meta.json on disk.
units.headline: New setter adds from-selected-series hint to block meta
units.reason: Writes a new hint value into the persisted meta.json format, which external tools read.
focus: Consumers of meta.json (Thanos, Mimir, promtool) that may not handle the new "from-selected-series" hint

units.summary: Adds a predicate that reports whether the block's hints include "from-selected-series". Callers use it to propagate the hint during compaction and to leave these blocks out of the in-order max time.
units.headline: New predicate checks for the from-selected-series hint
units.reason: Simple read-only predicate that mirrors FromStaleSeries; its callers carry the actual risk.

units.summary: New unit test covering the hint round-trip: absent at first, set once, a second call adds no duplicate, and it coexists with the stale-series hint. Test-only, so it cannot change production behavior.
units.headline: Tests setting the selected-series hint, idempotency, and coexistence
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: When Write receives a base meta that has the selected-series hint, the hint is now copied to the new block's meta, the same way the stale-series hint is. CompactSelectedSeries relies on this so its blocks carry the hint.
units.headline: Compactor Write propagates the selected-series hint from base meta
units.reason: Changes which hints get persisted to new blocks, and that affects later block handling.
focus: Blocks merged through Compact() lose this hint, same as stale-series today; check that's acceptable

units.summary: Blocks with the selected-series hint are now left out of the in-order max-time calculation, like OOO and stale-series blocks. Without this, a partial block of selected series could move the in-order watermark forward and change head compaction and OOO handling.
units.headline: inOrderBlocksMaxTime ignores selected-series blocks
units.reason: Changes the watermark logic that drives compaction and OOO handling.
focus: Callers of inOrderBlocksMaxTime that may now see ok=false when only selected-series blocks exist
Whether selected-series blocks that overlap later head blocks are handled correctly by overlap compaction

units.summary: New test: a series holding OOO data is skipped and stays in the head, while the other selected series is evicted into one block that carries the hint. Test-only.
units.headline: Tests that CompactSelectedSeries skips series with OOO data
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: New test that rewrites a selected-series block through compactor.Write and checks that the new meta still has the hint. Test-only.
units.headline: Tests that the selected-series hint propagates through compactor.Write
units.reason: New test only.

units.summary: New test checking that inOrderBlocksMaxTime reports no in-order block when the only block on disk is a selected-series block. Test-only.
units.headline: Tests that inOrderBlocksMaxTime excludes selected-series blocks
units.reason: New test only.
